ctx.x: Musicians in jazz history, (2nd) one of his principal influences.

Yeah. I heard the trumpet players now doing Freddy Hubbard and a lot of the things that he does reminds me of Rex Stewart. You see, Rex Stewart was a great trumpet player, he was an innovator, you know, and a lot of the things that the trumpet players are doing now, and especially Freddy Hubbard, reminds me of what Rex Stewart was doing then. And I'm sure that Freddy's probably aware of this, you know, but so much of this has been done that the average student or young musicians now aren't aware of. And I think…
In going back through our tapes so far, there are a few things I wanted to ask you. You mentioned your grandmother, and she was a very good pianist.
